Case note: R.C.S. No. 2873/2022
Client: Thomas Mehra (hardware dealer, Kolhapur)
Opposing party: Ananya Goyal
Court: Kolhapur District Court
Filed on: 18 January 2022
Claim amount: INR 3,33,00,000/-
Issue: land dispute. Construction has started on the disputed plot.
Advice given: Seek a temporary injunction to stop construction on the plot.
Outcome: A temporary injunction was granted.
Recommended next step: File a contempt petition if construction continues.
